expected_response.basis: No registered bounded edit can express the diagnostic pair-shell or shape contrasts, and no landmark index has a coherent signed direction.
expected_response.expected_effect: No change to the incumbent coordinate program; final predicted target affinity remains the primary objective with validity and strain secondary.

failure_modes: A batch subset in which pair_kernel_1.5 or pair_kernel_2.5 reverses sign or loses its positive batch fraction would weaken the short-shell direction, but this cannot be expressed by any registered edit because the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel term.

A landmark region_index edit could displace surrounding coordinates without a defensible expected affinity advantage, since landmark occupancy/softmin endpoint signs are mixed (endpoint_effects:14/15/16) and the regional attention term is detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention.

A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit would rely on continuous trends that are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed and polynomial acceptance rejected (continuous:0/1; curve_support), so it risks changing regional attention without validated benefit.

Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity would overstate expected affinity benefit, since decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false and lineage_support states the survival tests are not terminal affinity effects.

parameter_origins.formula_registry: supplied formula registry describing the executing pointcloud scalar

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible signed contrasts are the short-range pair-distance shells pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 (endpoint_effects:9/10/11; branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241) with pair_kernel_7.0 reversed (endpoint_effects:13; branch_adjusted:167/244), plus negative shape_yy/shape_xx (endpoint_effects:3/4; branch_adjusted:158/235) and mixed landmark occupancy/softmin signs (endpoint_effects:14/15/16). However, the executing pointcloud scalar in the formula_registry contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; those effects are diagnostic only, so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express the pair-shell or shape direction. The permitted region_index/temporal_region_index edits act through detached Gaussian landmark attention, and the landmark occupancy/softmin contrasts are mixed in sign rather than a single coherent direction, so no landmark index has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent. The joint-motion diagnostics (branch_adjusted:74/76/228/230/305/307; joint_diagnostics:1/2/11) are descriptive within-selector associations, not evidence of neural-module causation, and the information_audit explicitly states its excess-distance metric is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian. Continuous trends are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed and polynomial acceptance rejected (continuous:0/1; curve_support), so they do not justify a temporal blend. Temperatures are immutable (fixed_parameters; teacher_modes temperature_edits false) and no temperature edit is proposed. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable and survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, so affinity-first priority is not met by any available coordinate edit; retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice.
